required_distinctions: same diagnosis family across experience levels
permissible_alternatives: honest clarification or abstention when evidence is insufficient

label_corrections_before_freeze.rationale: The initial labels collapsed valid existing candidate families. The corrected sets retain the originally intended diagnosis families and add already-present, equally provisional alternatives: equalization/vocal production for a vocal masking report.

Initial labels used shorthand that does not exist in the P16 domain taxonomy. They were normalized to the pre-existing canonical domain names sidechain_routing_ducking, bounce_export_stems, and freeze_cpu_management.

These are semantic-family corrections made before final tuning: the existing compression reverb-duck card addresses washed-out vocal words; automation_modes_troubleshooting is the canonical snapping-fader family; and Flex vocal artifacts can require either timing or vocal-production diagnosis.

Evaluation categories were made explicit before final tuning. Authority-adversarial and P17-isolation cases exercise product boundaries rather than ordinary retrieval abstention; only the general plugin request is an ordinary no-match precision/recall case.
Held-out noisy, misspelled, confounded, ambiguous, and multiturn-style reports were added before the confidence calibration pass. Their acceptable families use existing P16 taxonomy only.

calibration_before_final_run.rationale: On the frozen suite, valid thin-context reports score at least 27.05 while the ordinary two-term no-match has only one unique overlap and score 15.05. A long multiturn report has nine normalized terms but three unique matches and a 52.54 top score; 0.20 coverage preserves the universal two-match floor without letting prior-experiment filler demand four matches.

boundary: Cases, labels, and this manifest are evaluation-only. They must not enter the permanent policy, product bundle, runtime index, provider context, or tool output.
